headline: Week 8: add a kicker and an RB, start Brissett at Dallas, and set Golden before Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific.
alerts: Sleeper could not be reached this run, so the roster is from Sunday and waiver targets could not be checked against league rosters. Confirm in the app.
You have no kicker. Add Chad Ryland (ARI) or Jake Bates (DET) before Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific.
Packers play Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific. Golden and Lloyd lock then.
Terry McLaurin is out for the season and Jake Ferguson had 0 catches Monday. Both are drop candidates.
Breece Hall missed a third straight game. Watch Wednesday and Thursday practice reports.
Daylight saving time ends Sunday Nov. 1. Early games still kick off at 10:00 AM Pacific.

ARI.note: At Dallas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Cowboys -6.5, total 53.5. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) missed two straight games.

DAL.note: Hosts Arizona Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Cowboys about 30 implied. Javonte Williams ran for over 150 yards Monday.

GB.note: Hosts Carolina Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific on a short week. Packers -3.5, total 47.5. Centers Sean Rhyan and Jacob Monk not expected to play.

DET.note: Hosts Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Lions -3.5, total 45.5. CB Ennis Rakestraw hurt his ankle.

MIN.note: At Detroit Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. RB Aaron Jones aggravated his knee and is day to day.

IND.note: At Jacksonville Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jaguars -7.5, total 46.5. Colts are 2-5 and may trade Jonathan Taylor.

LAC.note: At the Rams Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific, coming off the bye. Rams -7.5, total 43.5.

NYJ.note: Hosts Las Vegas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -1.5, total 44.5.

ATL.note: At Tampa Bay Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bucs -2.5, total 44.5.

WAS.note: Hosts Philadelphia Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Terry McLaurin is out for the season.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: Threw 27 of 48 for 272 yards and 1 TD in the 30-16 loss to Denver. He stays the starter.
At Dallas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Cowboys -6.5, total 53.5, Arizona about 23.5 implied, one of the best QB setups of the week.
Heavy pass volume continues while RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) has missed two straight games.
